why: Chosen from client.models.list() (135 models visible to this key, listed 2026-10-13). OpenAI's models page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/models) describes gpt-6-astra as 'our flagship model for complex reasoning and coding' and 'our most capable model for the most demanding work'; it accepts reasoning effort low/medium/high/xhigh/max. Newer-dated gpt-6.1-sol is described as 'near-Astra performance for complex work at a lower cost' — a cheaper tier, not the flagship. Override with the OPENAI_MODEL environment variable.
